title: Canonical scalar identity units
statement: For any scheme Z, any family p of the existing scalar extension presentations on Z, and any successive normalization n of p, there exists a family Units(p). Concretely, E_id ≅ Id sends the sheafified pure tensor s⊗x to sx. There is also L E_id ≅ Id whose component at QP, for every flat-term K-flat P, equals the canonical computation c_id(P) followed by Q of the degreewise multiplication isomorphism. The ordinary and derived maps are natural isomorphisms, in the fixed independent universes of [def-pur-clopen-derived-scalar-comparison-data].

proof.text:
scalar restriction along the identity is naturally the identity, section by
section. Uniqueness of left adjoints therefore identifies ordinary extension with
the identity. The adjunction unit is 1 tensor x, so linearity gives s tensor x maps
to sx. Pass multiplication to complexes and homotopy categories. Its inverse,
followed by Qh, makes the identity derived functor a left derived functor. Uniqueness
of left derived functors identifies the recorded presentation with this functor.
The defining counit equation gives the asserted representative formula after
conjugating by the canonical quotient-to-derived comparison.
